name: UniConverter 13 Installer
product: Wondershare UniConverter 13 installer by Wondershare

evidence.says: Wondershare's Mac download instructions identify the downloaded app as the UniConverter installer used to install the video converter.

notes: The same generic com.wondershare.Installer identifier was scanned for both UniConverter and PDFelement installers.

name: MultiCam Capture and Editing
product: Corel/Roxio MultiCam Capture and Editing, a Toast Extras component

evidence.says: The Toast Titanium manual lists MultiCam Capture and Editing among the applications bundled in its Extras menu.
Corel documents com.Corel.Toast.MCE preferences and saved state as part of the Toast installation.

limitation: The bundled executable architecture was not verified.
notes: The independently launchable Extras utility is distributed with Toast.

name: 4K Slideshow Maker
product: 4K Slideshow Maker by 4K Download (Open Media / InterPromo GmbH)

evidence.says: The vendor lists its latest Mac download as 2.0.1.1055, dated October 29, 2021, and inspection of the linked 4kslideshowmaker_2.0.1.dmg found an x86_64-only executable at 4K Slideshow Maker.app/Contents/MacOS/4kslideshowmaker.
Homebrew sets its Rosetta caveat for the same Mac disk image.

limitation: Homebrew declares Rosetta 2 a requirement. Successful operation under Rosetta has not been verified by the vendor or a firsthand user report.
notes: The vendor lists release 2.0.1.1055. The matching app plist reports short version 2.0 and bundle build 2.0.1.

name: Contexts
product: Contexts 3 window switcher by Contexts for Mac

evidence.says: The stable release notes explicitly say that Contexts 3.9.0 added native Apple Silicon support on August 27, 2022.
The vendor continues to offer Contexts 3.9 for download.

name: PhotoScapeX
product: PhotoScape X for Mac by Mooii Tech

evidence.says: The developer's Mac App Store release notes explicitly list native Apple Silicon support in version 4.3.1 on macOS 13 or later.
Apple's metadata confirms bundle org.photoscape.PhotoScapeX and the October 8, 2026 release date for 4.3.1.

notes: The developer first listed native support in the release notes for 4.3.

name: Texifier
product: Texifier for macOS, formerly Texpad, by Valletta Ventures

evidence.says: The vendor lists the official macOS release of Texifier 1.9.33 on January 16, 2026, with a direct download.
The vendor explicitly says the current macOS distribution is a universal binary with native code for Apple Silicon and Intel.

notes: Retains the Texpad bundle identifier despite the rename.

name: Smaart
product: Smaart v8 by Rational Acoustics

evidence.says: The latest v8 release in the vendor's changelog is 8.5.2, which fixed a memory leak on M1 Macs.
Rational Acoustics confirms it tested Smaart v8 on Apple Silicon through Rosetta.
The vendor identifies Smaart v8 as Intel-based and says it will cease to run on Apple Silicon Macs when macOS 28 drops general Rosetta support.

limitation: Rosetta and compatible audio-interface drivers are required.
notes: The scanned app is v8; the separately marketed Smaart v9 line is native.

name: Mixed In Key 10
product: Mixed In Key 10 by Mixed In Key LLC

evidence.says: The vendor's version 10 product page says Mixed In Key 10 runs natively on M1 and M2 Macs.

limitation: The vendor does not give the first native 10.x point release, so the old 10.1 scan cannot be reconciled to a specific build.
notes: The claim covers the version 10 line named by the vendor.

name: DotSpy
product: Artwork Systems DotSpy, later maintained by Esko

evidence.says: Esko explicitly declared DotSpy end-of-life because the 32-bit app would be incompatible with macOS Catalina.
The vendor manual identifies DotSpy 4.5 as a prepress image and separation viewer.

limitation: The vendor material consulted does not give the 4.5 release date.
notes: No native final release. Esko's end-of-life notice identifies the product as 32-bit.

name: nwjs
product: Vodafone TV for Computers by Vodafone Portugal

evidence.says: Vodafone's current setup guide directs computer users to the web player and lists installable apps for other devices.
Vodafone staff said its Mac desktop app did not support M1 Macs, and a customer later reported in the same thread that the app had been discontinued.

limitation: The final Mac app version and its architecture were not independently verified.
notes: The bundle and scan filename identify Vodafone's former desktop TV app, which used the NW.js runtime. Current desktop viewing is via the web player.

name: beook
product: beook, the learning-material and ebook reader by ionesoft GmbH

evidence.says: ionesoft offers separate macOS downloads, with its current Apple Silicon link pointing to beook_macosx_aarch64_install_9.7.6.pkg.
The official aarch64 package for 9.7.6 is available from the vendor's download server.
The vendor dates 9.7.6 to August 10, 2026, and identifies macOS aarch64 support in its 9.5.1 release notes.

notes: beook also offers a separate web version.

name: Binance
product: Binance Desktop by Binance

evidence.says: Binance offers an official macOS desktop trading client.
The live Homebrew cask identifies 2.6.1 and selects distinct arm64 and x64 disk images from Binance's own download server.
Binance's production download server serves the separately named 2.6.1 arm64 disk image.

limitation: The release date and runtime behavior were not verified.

name: Google Assistant
product: Google Assistant Unofficial Desktop Client by Melvin Abraham

evidence.says: Maintainer Melvin Abraham officially sunset the project in May 2026 and stated that it is no longer maintained.
The official release metadata dates 1.1.0 to October 29, 2022 and lists its Mac ZIP.
Binary inspection of Google Assistant.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Assistant in the official 1.1.0 Mac ZIP found an x86_64-only Mach-O, and its Info.plist confirmed the bundle and version.

limitation: Runtime behavior and authentication were not tested.
notes: This is an unofficial client rather than a Google-distributed app.

name: Mac Cache Cleaner
product: Mac Cache Cleaner by Kaunteya Suryawanshi

evidence.says: The official release feed shows version 1.2 from July 30, 2019 as the newest release and lists the Mac ZIP.
Binary inspection of Mac Cache Cleaner.app/Contents/MacOS/Mac Cache Cleaner in the official 1.2 ZIP found an x86_64-only Mach-O, and its Info.plist matched the bundle and version.

limitation: No credible report confirmed that version 1.2 runs under Rosetta 2.

name: Mobalytics Desktop
product: Legacy Electron Mobalytics Desktop by Mobalytics

evidence.says: Mobalytics says the old Electron app is no longer supported and that new features are exclusive to its Overwolf replacement.
The current Mobalytics site offers its desktop app for Windows.

limitation: The final standalone Mac release version and architecture were not established.
notes: The scanned bundle is the original Electron desktop client.

name: Prepros
product: Prepros by Subash Pathak

evidence.says: Prepros offers separate Apple Silicon and Intel downloads for macOS, and the live Apple Silicon link resolves to the 7.40.8 ZIP.
The vendor lists version 7.40.8 at the top of its release notes.

name: Maxon PluralEyes
product: Maxon PluralEyes (formerly Red Giant PluralEyes)

evidence.says: Maxon ended active development and scheduled one year of critical fixes and support for PluralEyes 2023.0.0 in its February 2023 announcement.
MacUpdater's archived record for this exact bundle dates version 2023.0.0 to August 31, 2022 and reports an Intel architecture.

limitation: The final Mac architecture and date come from MacUpdater's catalog.
notes: The final documented version was Intel-only according to the catalog.

name: LimeChat
product: LimeChat for Mac (Mac App Store edition) by Satoshi Nakagawa

evidence.says: The developer's Mac App Store listing still shows version 2.47 dated June 23, 2020.
The version 2.47 listing identifies Intel 64 and includes a user report that this App Store version runs under Rosetta 2.
The upstream discussion distinguishes self-built Apple Silicon binaries from the Intel Mac App Store release.

limitation: Rosetta behavior is based on a user report rather than independent runtime testing.
notes: MacPorts and source builds can be native, while the scanned bundle is specifically the Mac App Store edition.

name: Bookmark Maker
product: Bookmark Maker by Techion (Michael Page)

evidence.says: The vendor supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs and directs users to the Mac App Store edition.
Apple’s live catalog confirms that the exact bundle still ships as version 1.6, released August 9, 2018.
The original scan of the same bundle at version 1.6 and build 1.6 shows only a 64-bit x86 Mach-O executable.

limitation: Rosetta follows from the vendor’s hardware compatibility claim and the x86_64 scan of the same version still shipped by Apple. The current download was not independently tested.

name: BrowserStackLocal
product: BrowserStack Local desktop app by BrowserStack

evidence.says: BrowserStack supplies separate Arm64 and x64 installers under Local native application, alongside distinct command-line downloads.
Inspection of the official macOS Arm64 package gave bundle com.browserstack.local, version 3.7.8, and a 64-bit arm64 Mach-O at Contents/MacOS/BrowserStackLocal.app.

limitation: The release date of the Arm64 package was not established.
notes: Homebrew's cask selects the Intel desktop build, so use the vendor's Arm64 installer.

name: NZBVortex 3
product: NZBVortex 3 Usenet client by NZBVortex (VortexApps)

evidence.says: The App Store lists version 3.4.3 dated February 10, 2018, and a user reports it runs while macOS warns about Intel-only apps.
Homebrew identifies its 3.4.3 package as an Intel build requiring Rosetta 2.

limitation: Compatibility comes from the cask and a user report rather than a vendor test.
notes: The Mac App Store still offers 3.4.3 even though the Homebrew cask is disabled.

name: Papers
product: Papers desktop reference manager by ReadCube (Digital Science)

evidence.says: ReadCube provides separate Apple Silicon and Intel desktop app ZIPs and documents the Papers 4 (Legacy) rename during upgrades.
The official Apple Silicon ZIP contains Papers.app version 5.0.32 with the same com.ReadCube.Papers bundle ID and a 64-bit arm64 Mach-O at Contents/MacOS/Papers.

limitation: The desktop release date was not established.
notes: Homebrew's 4.37.2395 is for the legacy generation, which ReadCube allows alongside its current desktop app.

name: Epson iProjection
product: Epson iProjection for Mac by Seiko Epson (formerly EasyMP Multi PC Projection)

evidence.says: Epson dates the Mac 4.04 release and distributes iProV404Mac_WEB.dmg, whose app plist matches the scanned bundle and whose Contents/MacOS/Epson iProjection executable was inspected and is x86_64 only.
Epson's operation guide includes Apple M1 or later in the Mac CPU requirements for the current generation of iProjection.

limitation: Epson lists Apple Silicon support without explicitly naming Rosetta, and runtime was not tested.
notes: For the inspected Intel-only executable, Epson's stated Apple Silicon compatibility implies Rosetta 2.

name: ChemLab Evaluation
product: Model ChemLab v5 Evaluation by Model Science Software Inc.

evidence.says: The vendor offers the Mac Evaluation edition, and inspection of the linked ChemLab_v501s_Eval.dmg found that Contents/MacOS/ChemLab Evaluation is x86_64 only with version 5.05 in the matching bundle's plist.

limitation: Rosetta 2 operation and the release date are unverified.
notes: The download label suggests v5.01, but the actual app reports 5.05. App Store release notes for the separate Standard edition do not establish the Evaluation edition's architecture.

name: Electron Shark-mac-client
product: Douyu Live (斗鱼直播) desktop Mac client by DouYu

evidence.says: The vendor labels its desktop Mac download 1.3.8, but inspection of the linked douyu_client_123_0v1_3_8.dmg found version 1.3.9 in the matching bundle's plist and an x86_64-only Contents/MacOS/斗鱼直播 executable.

limitation: Rosetta operation and the release date of the actual 1.3.9 build are unverified.
notes: The public version label and DMG filename say 1.3.8, while the enclosed app explicitly reports 1.3.9.

name: Asset Catalog Tinkerer
product: Asset Catalog Tinkerer by Guilherme Rambo

evidence.says: The official 2.9 release distributes AssetCatalogTinkerer_v2.9-290.zip, whose matching app plist reports 2.9 and whose Contents/MacOS/Asset Catalog Tinkerer executable was inspected and is universal x86_64 and arm64.
GitHub lists the versioned release archive and timestamps the asset August 10, 2024.

name: NetSpot
product: NetSpot Wi-Fi analyzer and site survey app by Etwok

evidence.says: Etwok announced NetSpot 6.1 for macOS on November 16, 2026, and offers it via direct download and app updates.
The updater feed used by the scanned com.etwok.netspot app offers Etwok's version 5.1.4971, whose inspected package already uses com.etwok.netspotwifi.
The current official disk image contains com.etwok.netspotwifi version 6.1.6456 with x86_64 and arm64 slices at NetSpot.app/Contents/MacOS/NetSpot.

notes: Etwok changed the bundle ID from com.etwok.netspot to com.etwok.netspotwifi in the same product's update path.

name: Planets -- Live Wallpaper
product: Planets -- Live Wallpaper by Sergey Vdovenko / Lifeware Solutions

evidence.says: Apple's live catalog confirms the exact bundle ID and lists version 1.1, released February 8, 2013.
The original scanner report identifies the same bundle and version 1.1 and lists X86 as its only architecture.

limitation: The published scan gives X86 without a bitness and current Rosetta behavior is unverified.

name: Betaflight Configurator
product: Legacy NW.js Betaflight Configurator for macOS by the Betaflight project

evidence.says: Betaflight documents that it retired its NW.js desktop wrapper after Configurator 10.10.0 and moved its code to a web app.
The official release metadata dates 10.10.0 to April 28, 2024 and lists the macOS DMG.
Homebrew identifies the legacy 10.10.0 build as Intel-only and requiring Rosetta 2.
Betaflight distributes a newer 2026.6.2 desktop app with separate Apple Silicon and Intel macOS downloads.
The 2026.6.2 Tauri app uses the new com.betaflight.app bundle ID.

notes: The final NW.js build was Intel-only with Rosetta 2 support. The native Betaflight App release belongs to a different desktop bundle.

name: BatChmod
product: BatChmod file permissions utility by Lagente Software

evidence.says: MacUpdate lists BatChmod 1.7b5 with 32-bit and 64-bit Intel slices and states that the app is no longer developed or supported.
A firsthand Sonoma test identifies 1.7b5 as the last release, distributed through third-party archives, and reports that permission changes worked but force-emptying the Trash did not.
The scan under the exact com.lagente.batchmod bundle reports two x86 slices for 1.7b5.

limitation: No matching publisher release date or Apple Silicon runtime test was found.
notes: The final known build was non-native.

name: Chicken of the VNC
product: Chicken of the VNC by Geekspiff (Jason Harris)

evidence.says: The original project's release index lists 2.0b4 dated January 18, 2006 and says the project was superseded by the separate Chicken project.
Inspection of the project's cotvnc-20b4.dmg found the exact 2.0b4 bundle and only 32-bit PowerPC and i386 slices in Contents/MacOS/Chicken of the VNC.

notes: The final release has no arm64 or x86_64 slice. Its replacement Chicken is a separate project.

name: Color Efex Pro 5
product: DxO Color Efex Pro 5, the standalone-capable editor shipped in Nik Collection 5

evidence.says: DxO explicitly identifies Color Efex Pro 5 as the Color Efex editor included in Nik Collection 5.
DxO says the Nik Collection editors can run in standalone mode without a host application.
The macOS notes for Nik Collection 5.13 list Apple Silicon hardware support at the suite level without stating the architecture of the Color Efex Pro 5 executable.

limitation: The exact Color Efex Pro 5 build number and whether its executable is arm64 or Intel-only remain unverified.
notes: The public release notes give the suite version, 5.13. Apple Silicon claims for later major versions of Nik Collection do not establish this editor's architecture.

name: Slideshow Maker Movavi
product: Movavi Slideshow Maker, the Mac App Store edition by Movavi

evidence.says: Apple's public catalog returns zero results for the former Movavi Slideshow Maker storefront ID.
The original scan identifies the App Store bundle com.movavi.slideshowappstore at 8.0.1 with X86 as its only reported architecture.
Movavi's former slideshow product page now offers Movavi Video Editor instead.

limitation: 8.0.1 is the last verified App Store build, with an Intel scan; a formal delisting announcement and a definitive final build were not found.
notes: This disposition covers the former App Store edition. Movavi's requirements catalog separately lists its direct-download Slideshow Maker 2026 version 25.0.1 as requiring a 64-bit Intel processor.

name: MyDVD Pro
product: Corel MyDVD Pro for Mac, the standalone Roxio disc-authoring edition

evidence.says: Corel identifies standalone MyDVD Pro and links its former Mac App Store listing at ID 1192759741.
Apple's public catalog returns zero results for the former standalone MyDVD Pro listing.
Corel documents current MyDVD video-disc authoring as integrated into Toast 19 and 20.
The original scanner found only X86 for MyDVD Pro 1.2.8, build 88, with bundle ID com.corel.Toast.MyDVD.

limitation: Standalone distribution has disappeared from the linked catalog; the official final version and architecture were not established.
notes: This covers standalone distribution. Toast also distributed a MyDVD Pro component with the same bundle ID, and the current suite integrates MyDVD features.

name: WebVideoHunter
product: WebVideoHunter (formerly YouTubeHunter), Mac video downloader by Capibara

evidence.says: The original user scan identifies Capibara's exact bundle at 5.9.7 and reports X86 as its only architecture.
The historical software listing identifies Capibara and documents the older 5.8.6 as Intel-only.

limitation: The vendor domain did not resolve, and no current official release, retirement statement, or Rosetta report was found.

name: TraX
product: TraX Audio SACD Extractor by ByteWizard Ltd.

evidence.says: The original scanner found X86 for ByteWizard.TraX version 3.1.1, build 11251.
The product is identified as ByteWizard's directly sold Mac SACD extraction tool.
The archive documents the older Intel 2.5.7 and includes a user's report of a failed launch on a Mac Studio.

limitation: The developer product page is unavailable, and neither a current official build nor Rosetta behavior for the scanned 3.1.1 could be established.

name: Topaz ReMask 5
product: Topaz ReMask 5 standalone photo editor and plug-in by Topaz Labs

evidence.says: Topaz lists ReMask among legacy products no longer developed or sold, and its archived topazremask5.dmg contains the matching app with an x86_64-only Contents/MacOS/Topaz ReMask 5 executable.
Topaz's version 5 manual documents a standalone editor installed in the Mac Applications folder and optional use as a plug-in.

limitation: The legacy download does not identify a point release in the app plist.
notes: The archived Mac release is Intel-only.

name: Transformice
product: Transformice Electron macOS standalone by Atelier 801

evidence.says: Atelier 801 identifies the historical Mac standalone as an Electron 10 app built to host the 64-bit Pepper Flash plug-in.
The vendor's Mac standalone repository has no published release assets.
The publisher's Steam listing offers a macOS game but does not identify the current Mac client bundle or CPU architecture.
The historical scan of com.electron.transformice 1.0.0 detected an x86 executable.

limitation: Could not establish whether the current Steam Mac download matches the scanned Electron bundle or verify the architecture or runtime behavior of a current build.

name: Kingsoft Kdocs Mac
product: KDocs (金山文档) standalone Mac client by Kingsoft Office Software

evidence.says: Kingsoft offers the dedicated KDocs desktop app for Mac through its download page.
The vendor's download configuration identifies 3.11.7 as the official Mac download and supplies the versioned DMG URL.
Binary inspection of 金山文档.app/Contents/MacOS/金山文档 in the official 3.11.7 DMG found an x86_64-only Mach-O, and Info.plist confirmed com.kingsoft.kdocs.mac and version 3.11.7.
The Homebrew cask documents that its Intel build of this same app requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.
A Mac user documents KDocs as an Intel app that opens through Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

limitation: The vendor did not provide a release date or a runtime statement for 3.11.7 specifically.
notes: This is the standalone KDocs client, distinct from the WPS Office suite.

name: Swift Publisher 4
product: Swift Publisher 4 by BeLight Software

evidence.says: BeLight documents migration from the distinct Swift Publisher 4 bundle to Swift Publisher 5, explicitly naming com.belightsoft.SwiftPublisher4.
The vendor's release history ends the 4.x line at 4.0.5 and introduces native Apple Silicon support in the newer 5.5.9 release.
BeLight's current Mac support and download page offers the maintained 5.x release only.
The historical scan for com.belightsoft.SwiftPublisher4 version 4.0.5 reports an x86 executable.

limitation: No formal end-of-life notice, precise release date or Apple Silicon runtime result for 4.0.5 was found.
notes: The final documented 4.x release was non-native. The separately identified Swift Publisher 5 line ships native Apple Silicon support.
